item.description:
What's new in CapyBar 1.0.2

  • Thermal pressure is now a Cool / Fair / Stressed pill, and it can change the capybara when the Mac actually heats up.
  • The icon color follows the average of the stats you track, so one metric near a threshold no longer paints the whole capy yellow.
  • Disk and network stay out of the icon color unless you turn them on.
  • Settings uses a two-column card layout that fills the window.
